purpose: Executable ledger for the `matter-spectrum-coupling-mass` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Particle-spectrum rows make matter content, chiral spectra, hidden sectors, source populations, and effective excitations auditable. They can cap, freeze, demote, or roll back spectrum wording, but they do not recover the Standard Model or promote a route.

particle_spectrum_rows.spectrum_object: Matter, particle, excitation, source-population, dark-sector, benchmark-feature, or effective-state spectrum claimed by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
particle_spectrum_rows.chirality_or_representation_rule: Declare gauge representation, chirality, generation count, external-state basis, source/detector species, or effective sector. A spectrum row does not identify ontology unless representation and quotient rules are public and route-native.
particle_spectrum_rows.multiplicity_or_generation_count: Record whether multiplicity is observed, compactification-derived, simulator-generated, ensemble-counted, source-population-inferred, or metadata-only. Degeneracy and duplicate-sector counting remain residual unless explicitly quotiented.
particle_spectrum_rows.dark_hidden_or_exotic_sector_risk: Failure appears when hidden sectors, sterile species, extra vacua, exotic representations, unobserved thresholds, benchmark labels, catalog source classes, or dark-sector parameterizations can change the claimed spectrum without changing the public record.
particle_spectrum_rows.observed_sector_gap: The row can constrain particle-content language, but it does not recover the full Standard Model matter sector, neutrino sector, Higgs sector, dark sector, or observed couplings without the coupling and mass/hierarchy rows. QCD/hadronic spectrum, color confinement, lattice scale-setting, and quark/gluon-to-hadron matching remain denominator burdens.
particle_spectrum_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer Standard Model recovery, chiral matter completion, unique spectrum, dark-sector identification, or candidate-native matter ontology from one route-local spectrum row.
particle_spectrum_rows.observed_sector_matter_credit_rule: This row names source species, detector masses, external states, effective parameters, public-data products, or calibration denominators only. It is forbidden to spend it as Standard Model matter recovery or observed-sector ontology credit for this route.
particle_spectrum_rows.qcd_hadronic_credit_rule: QCD/hadronic public records constrain color, confinement, alpha_s/running, scale setting, quark-mass/hadron-spectrum, jet/PDF, and lattice-continuum wording; they are not candidate-native support, evidence-unit credit, or route promotion.
particle_spectrum_rows.qcd_hadronic_replay_burden: Name whether quark/gluon confinement, color-neutral hadron spectrum, baryon/meson scale setting, and lattice-QCD low-energy inputs are derived, assumed, selected, or outside scope.
particle_spectrum_rows.electroweak_flavor_credit_rule: Electroweak precision, CKM/flavor, and neutrino agreement is denominator pressure only, not acquired candidate-native support, not Standard Model derivation, not neutrino-mass solution, and not route promotion.
particle_spectrum_rows.electroweak_flavor_replay_burden: Declare W/Z/Higgs input scheme, electroweak-fit convention, CKM/PMNS definitions, flavor/CP observable set, neutrino ordering and phase assumptions, direct/sterile mass boundary, fit correlations/tensions, and public-record custody before electroweak, flavor, neutrino, or matter-recovery wording is spent.
